name: Expenses
description: Note what you spend money on, and see where each month went.
title: Expenses
addForgotten: Add an expense for this day
saveFailed: Couldn't save that. Please try again.
dayLockedPast: This day is in the past, so it's locked. Tap to make changes.
dayUnlockedHint: Unlocked for editing. Tap to lock this day again.
amountInvalid: That doesn't look like an amount.
categoriesDescription: Rename any category, or retire the ones you don't use. Retired categories keep their name on past expenses.
addExpenseDescription: For today or any day before it.
emptyPageDescription: Add one here, or from the diary's day page as you go.
ratesUnavailable: No exchange rate for this pair.
ratesNothingToCompare: Pick another currency to compare yours with.
ratesSource: Rates from {{date}}, as published by currency-api. For reference only.
ratesNote: Other currencies converted at exchange rates from {{date}}.
ratesStale: These exchange rates are from {{date}}, more than a week ago, so converted totals may be off. They'll update the next time you're online.
ratesMissing_one: No exchange rate for {{currencies}}, so those expenses are left out of the totals.
ratesMissing_other: No exchange rates for {{currencies}}, so those expenses are left out of the totals.
defaultCurrencyDescription: Pre-selected for new expenses. You can still pick another one for any single expense.
exportNote: A day with spending carries a total line, then one line per expense as `- <amount>: <description> (<category>)`. The description and the category are each left out when absent. Amounts are never converted between currencies, so a day with more than one lists each total separately.
exportCurrenciesSeparate: Amounts are never converted between currencies, so each currency is totalled on its own.

onboarding.previewNote: Just a preview — nothing here is saved.

day.title: Note it as you go
day.lede: An amount is all it needs. Add what it was and a category if you like — past days stay locked until you open them.

stats.title: See where the month went
stats.lede: Each month's total, how it sits among the months around it, and how it splits across categories. Tap a month to look at it.

calendar.title: At a glance on the calendar
calendar.lede: Days shade by how much was spent, compared with the rest of that month.
